verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs and CLI describe git-push deployment, serverless functions, isolated container execution, rollbacks, and incremental rollouts—all serverless/full-stack deployment without server management. Community evidence corroborates smooth onboarding for serverless deploys, though other threads raise unrelated security/billing concerns not specific to this axis. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of zero-ops serverless scaling and more detail on function cold-start/limits.
